g.text: Three aligned charts share identical basic-size and deviation scales, with metric limits from the supplied FE Handbook. Positive hole−shaft difference is

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #23313d

g.text: clearance; negative is interference. Minimum clearance uses smallest hole/largest shaft; minimum interference uses smallest shaft/largest hole. Overlap
